$comment: Quarter geometry mirrors filecoin-project/solstice deployments.json. Keep it in sync with
`npm run sync:deployments`, which pulls that file from upstream and rewrites addresses.
IMPORTANT -- which of these the cranker actually trusts at runtime:
activationEpoch   read from chain via quarterStart(0); the value here is a cross-check only
epochsPerQuarter  read from chain via EPOCHS_PER_QUARTER(); the value here is a cross-check only
postPeriod        CONFIG ONLY -- POST_PERIOD is `private immutable` on the SRA and cannot be read
verificationWindow CONFIG ONLY -- same, VERIFICATION_WINDOW is `private immutable`
So only postPeriod and verificationWindow can drift silently. The cranker cross-checks the
schedule they produce against aggregatedFilecoinPayVolume() on every run and alerts on divergence.

genesisUnix is the chain's genesis timestamp, so any epoch's wall-clock time is genesisUnix + epoch * epochSeconds. scripts/crank-simple.mjs uses it to schedule entirely from the clock, with no chain reads at all. Verified against two blocks 1000 epochs apart on each network. null on the devnet, whose epochs are not wall-clock.
